description: Du suchst keinen klassischen Job. Du suchst die maximale Herausforderung und ein Umfeld, das so ambitioniert ist wie Du. Die WTE Group baut und skaliert Unternehmen gegen den Fachkräftemangel. Mit WTE Charkos bringen wir Pflegefachkräfte aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Gespräch und einem eigenen Ausbildungszentrum in Mysore. Charkos wächst gegen den Markttrend. Mit WTE Companion entwickeln wir die App, die internationalen Fachkräften und Studenten das Ankommen in Deutschland abnimmt, von der Wohnung bis zum Bankkonto. Und mit unserem eigenen Software- und KI-Team bauen wir gerade ein Venture Studio auf, das neue KI-Produkte für die Branchen entwickelt, die wir aus dem Tagesgeschäft kennen. Dafür suchen wir die rechte Hand der beiden Gründer. Zunächst heißt das: Du arbeitest direkt mit uns, nimmst uns die Themen ab, die zwischen Strategie und Tagesgeschäft liegen, und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen fallen und umgesetzt werden. Wer das zwei bis drei Jahre auf Top-Niveau macht, hat alles gelernt, um danach selbst ein Venture der Gruppe zu führen. Was Du bei uns machst Rechte Hand der Gründer: Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, hältst die Fäden zwischen Hamburg, Mysore und unseren Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt, was die Geschäftsführung angestoßen hat. Sonderprojekte: Finanzierung, Partnerverhandlungen mit Banken und Versicherern, Ausschreibungen, Aufbau neuer Teams und Standorte. Du übernimmst, was gerade am wichtigsten ist, und bringst es zu Ende. Operative Exzellenz: Du übersetzt Strategie in Routinen, Zahlen und Prozesse, damit die Gruppe mit jedem neuen Venture stabiler wird statt chaotischer. Business Development: Du erkennst Wachstumschancen, baust strategische Partnerschaften auf und treibst Deals eigenständig bis zur Unterschrift. Venture Building: Du begleitest neue Produkte und Ventures aus dem Studio vom ersten Businessplan bis zur Marktreife, egal ob KI-Software oder Dienstleistung. Sparringspartner: Du forderst die Gründer heraus, lieferst Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf den Punkt und filterst, was wirklich auf den Tisch der Geschäftsführung gehört. Was Du mitbringst Exzellente Ausbildung: Studium mit herausragenden Ergebnissen, gern an einer der führenden Hochschulen. Nachgewiesene Spitzenleistung: Du hast schon einmal bewiesen, dass Du zu den Besten gehörst. Das muss kein wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund sein: Spitzensport, Musik, eine eigene Gründung oder ein anderes Feld mit höchstem Leistungsanspruch zählen genauso. Intelligenz und Hunger: Brillante Auffassungsgabe, unternehmerisches Denken und der feste Wille, in Zukunft selbst zu gründen. Macher-Mentalität: Du willst Dinge bewegen und tauchst ohne Scheu tief in die operative Umsetzung ein, vom Vertragsentwurf bis zur Excel-Tabelle. Technik-Affinität: Du musst nicht programmieren, aber Du verstehst, was KI heute kann, und arbeitest selbstverständlich damit. Kommunikation: Deutsch und Englisch auf Top-Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich. Unsere Teams sitzen in Hamburg und Indien. Was wir bieten Das Sprungbrett zur eigenen Gründung: Du lernst in zwei bis drei Jahren, wie man mehrere Unternehmen parallel aufbaut, finanziert und führt. Besser kann man sich auf die eigene Gründung nicht vorbereiten. Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den beiden Gründern, kurze Wege, keine Zwischenebene. Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Ambitionierte, intelligente Menschen in Hamburg und Mysore, die gemeinsam etwas Großes aufbauen wollen. Perspektive: Die Chance, bei zukünftigen Ventures der Gruppe direkt in den Driver’s Seat zu rücken. Arbeitsplatz: Wunderschönes, modernes Büro in Hamburg-Winterhude. Vergiss das Standard-Anschreiben. title: Head of Sales (m/w/d)
description: WTE Charkos bringt Pflegefachkräfte und Auszubildende aus Indien nach Deutschland, mit B2-Deutsch vor dem ersten Auswahlgespräch und einem eigenen Ausbildungs- und Sprachzentrum in Mysore. Unsere Kunden sind Universitätskliniken, kommunale und private Klinikträger und Altenpflege-Träger in ganz Deutschland. Wir tragen das RAL-Gütezeichen „Faire Anwerbung Pflege Deutschland” und arbeiten als anerkannter Dienstleister mit dem Freistaat Thüringen zusammen. Unser Modell funktioniert: Wir wachsen gegen den Markttrend, immer mehr Einrichtungen setzen auf unsere Fachkräfte und planen Folgekohorten mit uns. Damit das so bleibt, wollen wir unseren Vertrieb verstetigen und professionalisieren. Dafür suchen wir Dich: für unser Team in Deutschland und Indien, mit Büro in Hamburg. Was Du bei uns machst Neukunden: Du gewinnst neue Kunden in der Altenpflege und im Klinikmarkt: Träger mit mehreren Häusern, Klinikverbünde, Universitätskliniken. Outbound-Prozess: Du baust einen wiederholbaren Outbound-Prozess auf (Telefon, Mail, LinkedIn, Besuche vor Ort) und führst ihn selbst, statt ihn nur zu steuern. Abschluss: Du führst Erstgespräche, Bedarfsanalysen und Angebotsgespräche mit Geschäftsführung, Pflegedirektion und Personalleitung bis zur Unterschrift. Bestandskunden: Du entwickelst Kunden zu Folgekohorten und begleitest Ausschreibungen gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung. Pipeline: Du pflegst Pipeline und Kundenstand sauber, damit das Team in Hamburg und Mysore planen kann. Sichtbarkeit: Du vertrittst uns auf Fachkongressen und in Verbandsformaten. Was Du mitbringst Erfahrung: Mindestens fünf Jahre nachweisbarer Erfolg im B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Dienstleistungen, idealerweise mit Entscheidern im Gesundheitswesen oder im Personaldienstleistungsmarkt. Aufbau-Erfahrung: Du hast schon einmal einen Outbound-Prozess von null aufgebaut und kannst Zahlen dazu nennen. Arbeitsweise: Du telefonierst gern, schreibst klar und hältst Termine ein. Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch sicher (Team in Indien). Mobilität: Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, gelegentlich Indien. Fachwissen: Pflege-Fachwissen ist kein Muss, Lernbereitschaft schon. Was wir bieten Ein Produkt mit echter Nachfrage: Messbare Wirkung, nämlich besetzte Stellen in Einrichtungen, die sonst Betten sperren müssten. Nah an den Gründern: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege, Einblick in alle Teile des Geschäfts von Mysore bis zur Klinik. Rahmen: Festgehalt plus erfolgsabhängige Vergütung, wunderschönes, modernes Büro in Hamburg-Winterhude, Arbeit in einem hochmotivierten und ambitionierten Team. Indien: Reisen nach Mysore, um Kandidaten und Ausbildung selbst kennenzulernen. Vergiss das Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf, drei Sätze zu Deinem größten Vertriebserfolg und Deinen frühestmöglichen Starttermin. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

About the role

We are looking for a technically strong, proactive and detail-oriented Senior Product Integrity Engineer to join our UK team, with a focus on design assurance, engineering validation and product quality.

Embedded within the New Product Development (NPD) process, you will take ownership of product integrity activities from concept through to production launch, ensuring quality, safety, reliability and consumer expectations are built into the design.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Development, Manufacturing and Supply Chain to lead risk assessment and validation activities. You will use engineering judgement, test evidence and consumer insights to challenge designs, resolve risks and influence decisions at critical development milestones.

This role offers broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to directly influence whether our products deliver SharkNinja’s 5-star quality standard.

Key responsibilities

Design assurance and engineering validation

  • Lead product integrity input into design reviews, Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), design verification and validation planning (DVP&R), and safety reviews throughout the NPD lifecycle.

  • Own the development and delivery of risk-based verification and validation plans, establishing clear test methods, acceptance criteria and evidence requirements aligned with product specifications and applicable UK, European and other target-market requirements.

  • Challenge design assumptions and assess product performance, reliability, robustness and foreseeable use conditions, ensuring risks are understood and addressed before tooling and production release.

  • Evaluate engineering changes for their impact on quality, safety and performance, defining appropriate revalidation requirements to prevent regression.

  • Review and approve quality-related manufacturing and test documentation within your remit, ensuring requirements are clearly translated into production controls.

  • Contribute to Design for Manufacture (DFM) reviews, assessing tolerances, process capability and potential sources of manufacturing variation.

  • Provide evidence-based recommendations on product readiness, escalating unresolved risks and driving corrective action ahead of development milestones.

Cross-functional leadership and quality governance

  • Represent product integrity within cross-functional NPD teams, translating consumer expectations and quality requirements into practical engineering decisions.

  • Lead quality risk and action reviews, establishing clear ownership, priorities and closure criteria.

  • Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and suppliers to define process controls, quality gates and production acceptance criteria ahead of mass production.

  • Lead technical investigation of issues identified during prototype, pilot and pre-production builds, coordinating root-cause analysis and verifying corrective action effectiveness.

  • Challenge supplier 8D investigations and corrective action proposals, ensuring conclusions are supported by robust evidence.

  • Drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities addressing design and process gaps, tracking actions through to verified closure.

  • Provide technical guidance to colleagues and support the development of consistent product integrity practices across programmes.

Data analysis and continuous improvement

  • Analyse validation results, build data, test failures and relevant field performance insights to identify emerging risks and prioritise improvements.

  • Define and monitor quality metrics, validation coverage and acceptance criteria throughout the development cycle.

  • Apply lessons from existing products to new designs, strengthening test coverage and preventing repeat failures.

  • Improve validation methods and pre-production quality processes, addressing systemic gaps with sustainable solutions.

  • Communicate validation status, residual risks and corrective action progress clearly to senior management and cross-functional stakeholders.

Skills and experience

Essential

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, Quality Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Substantial relevant engineering experience, typically gained over five or more years, with demonstrated ownership of design verification, validation or product integrity activities.

  • Practical experience leading DFMEA, DVP&R, technical design reviews and engineering change assessments.

  • A strong understanding of product development lifecycles, design and document control, and verification and validation methodologies.

  • Experience translating product requirements and engineering risks into measurable test plans and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong technical problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to interpret test data and assess corrective action effectiveness.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams, challenge technical decisions constructively and drive issues through to resolution.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Confidence managing multiple programmes and competing priorities in a fast-paced development environment.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, with experience using data to support engineering decisions.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams, regions and supplier partners.

Desirable

  • Experience developing consumer appliances, electromechanical products or other high-volume consumer goods.

  • Experience working within rapid NPD cycles and supporting products through tooling, pilot builds and production launch.

  • Knowledge of reliability engineering, accelerated life testing, statistical analysis or Design of Experiments (DOE).

  • Familiarity with supplier quality processes, Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), process capability assessment and incoming quality controls.

  • Understanding of applicable product safety standards and UK and European product compliance requirements.

  • Experience incorporating human factors, usability and foreseeable misuse into product validation.

  • Experience working with international manufacturing partners and suppliers.

Travel

The role may require travel within the UK and internationally to support development builds, manufacturing sites and supplier activities.

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. While the primary focus is automation, the role also involves manual exploratory testing.

  • Alignement exécuteur & transversal : Collaborer étroitement avec la direction business globale, les responsables merchandising, les spécialistes SEO, les équipes de monétisation Retail Media et la tech IA pour aligner l'organisation sur les évolutions majeures de la plateforme.
  • Pilotage des métriques macro & performance du funnel : Suivre et optimiser les métriques clés tout au long du parcours : Trafic organique/direct, CTR de la recherche, profondeur de navigation, taux d'engagement conversationnel, rendement publicitaire (eCPM), taux de rebond, CTR vers les fiches produits (PDP) et conversion globale du haut de funnel.

2. Architecture fonctionnelle & Orchestration de l'écosystème Web

  • Architecte Fonctionnel·le Principal·e : Définir la répartition des périmètres entre les squads web (Search & Conversational Discovery, Taxonomy & Merchandising, Personalization/Recommendations, Retail Media & Sponsored Listings) afin d'éliminer les frictions et les doublons.

3. Sparring stratégique & De-risking Produit

  • Partenaire et mentor stratégique : Conseiller les Group Product Managers (GPM) et Product Managers (PM) du domaine E-Commerce web pour naviguer au sein des algorithmes de recherche complexes, des architectures d'agents LLM, des intégrations d'ad-servers et des contraintes web à très fort volume.
  • Stratégies de réduction des risques (De-risking) : Formuler et exécuter des boucles de validation rapides sur les concepts à forte incertitude (recherche visuelle/vocale, conseillers produits conversationnels, réapprovisionnement/bundles agentiques, placements sponsorisés).

  • Leadership IA, Agentique & Monétisation : Promouvoir l'adoption des solutions IA cloud-natives (ex: Google Vertex AI), des frameworks conversationnels, des modes d'achat agentiques et des fonctionnalités Retail Media pour amplifier à la fois l'expérience utilisateur et les revenus de la plateforme.

Context & project

Decathlon’s mission is to bring people together through sport and make wellbeing accessible for all. To align this mission with planet boundaries, Decathlon relies on In-Store teammates who embody the human touchpoint between our brand and our customers. This is exactly where your mission comes in: designing simple, efficient in-store experiences that make our teammates' lives easier, enabling them to be as effective and impactful as possible with our customers. Within an omnichannel context, your mission will be to combine operational excellence with user needs, bridging the gap between operational requirements, business objectives, and technological opportunities.

Digital plays a pivotal role in the quality of the connection built during moments shared between customers and teammates. How? By ensuring every In-Store Decathlonian works in an efficient and adapted environment that seamlessly supports their daily tasks.

In this context, we’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to level up our game on our famous In-Store Checkout. It offers a wealth of topics to tackle: friction, fluidity, autonomy, but also up-selling, authentication, and loyalty. It is one of our most signature experiences, well known by our customers.

As a Product Designer, you will join a cross-functional team (Product, Engineering, Business, etc.) and have the responsibility to design the future of the In-Store checkout, while continuously improving the living experience.

title: Staff Data Engineer
description:
The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.

The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change. 

One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines. 

That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.

Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.

Join us to help us build a more resilient world together. 

Role & Team

As a Staff Data Engineer at Overstory, you will lead the design and scaling of the data platform that enables Overstory’s AI-powered vegetation analysis. Our analysis depends on moving enormous volumes of satellite imagery, model inferences, and utility network data through orchestrated pipelines reliably, repeatably, and on time to support customer decision-making. You'll own the architecture of that platform and set the direction for how it evolves.

You'll work closely with data, ML, and product engineers, as well as product teams, to make sure the data flowing into our models and out to our customers balances pragmatic delivery with durability, traceability, and scalability. As a senior technical leader, you'll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and set standards for pipeline design, service boundaries, and data quality across Overstory.

Time zone requirement: Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)

What You'll Do

In collaboration with data, ML, and product colleagues, you will:

  • Architect and evolve our orchestration layer — asset graphs, quality checks, partitioning strategies, and the patterns that keep it scaling reliably.
  • Design and maintain production data pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data, from ingestion through transformation to delivery.
  • Lead system design work across the data platform, including service boundaries, data contracts, and designing around the failure modes that come with each.
  • Drive the shift toward a service-oriented architecture, decoupling tightly bound components into services that teams can own and deploy independently.
  • Build event-driven workflows, replacing brittle coupling and manual coordination with durable messaging patterns.
  • Establish observability, testing, and data quality frameworks so problems surface before customers see them, allowing any result to be traced back and explained.
  • Mentor engineers and define the standards for how we build, test, and operate data systems.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience thriving at the intersection of data engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale scientific data; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk and improve grid resilience through better data patterns and infrastructure
  • 10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems
  • Deep hands-on experience with Dagster — asset-based orchestration, partitions, sensors, and the operational side of running it in production (comparable experience with Airflow, Prefect, or similar is a reasonable substitute if you're ready to go deep on Dagster)
  • Proven track record building and operating data pipelines at scale, with a real feel for idempotency, backfills, and partitioning
  • Experience in preparing systems to handle periods of high demand with a focus on testability and scalability best practices
  • Strong system design skills — you can reason about boundaries, contracts, coupling, and failure modes, and explain the tradeoffs to people who'll use and build on them
  • Practical experience designing service-oriented architecture, including versioning and keeping things operational through migrations
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Google Cloud
  • Experience with Pub/Sub and event-driven patterns
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, ML, and product
  • Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers
  • Experience in remote-first and globally distributed team

Nice To Have

  • Comfort working with geospatial data and the ways that it’s stored
  • Experience building data pipelines that power ML training and inference
  • Experience with analytics engineering tooling and warehouse modeling in BigQuery
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience and comfort owning your systems in production
  • Background in remote sensing, forestry, or the utility sector

Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What We Offer

  • Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits 
  • Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around
  • Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets 
  • A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values
  • To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

About Our Team

We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.

We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration. 

Diversity & Inclusion

The climate crisis is a human crisis that requires diverse perspectives to solve. 

We place enormous value on diversity and believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds and experience work together. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.

Our Values

Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.

We act with urgency.

Our curiosity fuels our growth.

We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.

We’re rooted in diversity.

Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.

We care for each other.

We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.

Trust is fundamental.

We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. All hiring decisions are always made by people, not machines. Any data processed by AI is handled securely in line with GDPR and our Privacy Notice.

description:
Verbind ambitie met waarde — word het gezicht van onze groei

 

Wij geloven dat sales anders kan. En moet. 

Bij Schuberg Philis werken we aan missiekritische IT-omgevingen die simpelweg altijd moeten werken. Dat doen we al bijna 25 jaar voor organisaties die een groot stuk van Nederland draaiend houden: van banken en energiebedrijven tot publieke instellingen en transport & logistiek. Systemen die de ruggengraat vormen van Nederland. We leveren niet alleen technologie, maar vooral zekerheid en veranderkracht (weerbaar & wendbaar). En dat doen we op onze eigen manier.

Geen persoonlijke targets, geen bazen die bepalen wat je moet doen, geen cijfers om de cijfers. Wel 100% eigenaarschap. 100% kwaliteit. En 100% klanttevredenheid.

We staan aan de vooravond van een nieuwe groeifase. Uit recent strategisch onderzoek dat McKinsey voor ons heeft uitgevoerd, laat zien dat er enorme kansen liggen om onze naam met trots verder op de kaart te zetten. Daarom breiden we uit en willen we onze positie in Energie, Logistiek en Manufacturing industrie verder versterken. En zoeken we iemand die begrijpt dat groei niet begint bij pushen, maar bij luisteren.

 

 

De uitdaging

We zijn lang het best bewaarde geheim van de Nederlandse IT-wereld geweest. Nu is het tijd dat iedereen ons leert kennen. Weet jij hoe je deuren opent die normaal gesloten blijven? Kun jij complexe IT-uitdagingen vertalen naar strategische kansen? En ben jij klaar om de verborgen parel van de Nederlands IT wereld zichtbaar te maken voor klanten die niets minder dan 100% betrouwbaarheid eisen? Dan is dit het moment om aan boord te stappen.

Als Customer Director Sales New Logo krijg jij de vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid om Schuberg Philis te positioneren bij nieuwe klanten binnen de Energie, Logistiek en Manufacturing industrie. Je brengt onze proposities, zoals Cloud, Data & AI, Software en Security, onder de aandacht. Niet door harder te roepen, maar door scherper en beter te luisteren.

 

 

Wat jij brengt

  • Je bent een bouwer met commercieel instinct en inhoudelijke scherpte. Je weet hoe je een organisatie als Schuberg Philis positioneert: niet als leverancier, maar als partner die het verschil maakt wanneer het ertoe doet.
  • Je voelt je thuis op C-level. Je stelt de vragen die anderen niet durven te stellen. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen business-strategie en technologie n bouwt vertrouwen op door te luisteren, te duiden en samen te ontwerpen.
  • Je denkt ondernemend en handelt resultaatgericht. Je haalt energie uit groei, maar niet ten koste van kwaliteit. Je kijkt verder dan de deal van vandaag en bouwt relaties die jaren meegaan.
  • Je gelooft in diagnose before you prescribe. Je weet dat klanttevredenheid begint met écht begrijpen wat er speelt. Je spreekt de taal van IT, Cloud, Data & AI, Software en Security en vertaalt die kennis naar waarde op directieniveau. Dat betekent dat je verkoopt wat ze echt nodig hebben, in plaats van dat je iedere euro die je tegenkomt probeert binnen te hengelen.
  • Je bent een natuurlijke verbinder. Je hebt een relevant netwerk in de Energie, Logistiek of Manufacturing industrie en weet precies hoe je daarbinnen relaties opbouwt die verder gaan dan de transactie.

Onze divisie realiseert digitale transformaties die er echt toe doen. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor digitalisering van de brouwerijen van Heineken, de software op de treinen van NS, maar ook de duurzame energie certificaten van de ACT Group en KLM. Jij bouwt voort op dat fundament en brengt onze impact naar nieuwe klanten die even ambitieus zijn als wij.

 

 

Wat je meeneemt

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring en een bewezen trackrecord in het ontwikkelen van new business binnen complexe IT- of technologieomgevingen,
  • Aantoonbaar vermogen om vraag te creëren die omzetgroei realiseert,
  • Ervaring met Value Selling, bij voorkeur via MEDDPICC of vergelijkbare methodieken,
  • Een actief netwerk in de Energie, Logistiek of Manufacturing,
  • Ervaring met compliance-gevoelige domeinen (NIS2, DORA) is een plus,
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

 

 

Wat je krijgt

Een rol die groter is dan sales alleen. Bij Schuberg Philis werk je niet in een commerciële silo, maar in een multidisciplinair team van engineers, architecten en strategen. Samen bouwen jullie aan verandering die ertoe doet voor klanten, voor Nederland, en voor de continuïteit van systemen die nooit stil mogen vallen. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen koers te varen, met de support van een sterk merk, bewezen proposities en cases die gewicht hebben. Je werkt autonoom, maar nooit alleen. En ja, de lat ligt hoog. Maar dat is precies waarom jij hier wilt zijn.

title: Expert Model Trains
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact 
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your Mission

As a Model Trains Expert, your mission is to bring your specialist model trains expertise to the curation of high-quality, compelling auctions that attract engaged collectors and trusted sellers. Your knowledge of brands, rarity, condition, valuation, and collector expectations is central to ensuring each lot is relevant, accurately assessed, and commercially strong.

By combining deep category expertise with sound commercial judgement, you play a key role in growing the Model Trains category, maintaining transparency, and strengthening trust within the collector community.

What You’ll Do

  • Evaluate and arrange model train lots submitted by users, ensuring each auction features attractive and relevant listings
  • Create compelling weekly lot selections using your expertise and professional network
  • Review titles, descriptions, and images to assess quality and provide accurate estimated values
  • Safeguard transparent and fair transactions through consistent expert evaluation
  • Communicate rejections professionally and diplomatically, maintaining strong seller relationships
  • Collaborate with Sales to attract new sellers and diversify the range and quality of lots
  • Partner with Marketing to increase bidder engagement and visibility for your auctions

What You’ll Bring

  • Expert knowledge in Model Trains
  • Strong commercial acumen and documented commercial experience
  • An eye for trade and value within the collectibles market
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to act diplomatically in user disputes
  • A network of potential sellers and experts within your field
  • Good computer skills and confidence working with digital tools
  • Good command of English, written and spoken

Where You’ll Be

This is a 100% remote role that can be based in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Portugal, Spain, or the United Kingdom.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Senior Community & Customer Marketing Specialist (Bókun)
description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Job Location: This role is a hybrid position based out of either our London or Oxford office.

 

About Bókun:

Bókun, a subsidiary of Tripadvisor, is a rapidly growing travel technology company that offers cutting-edge solutions to the Tours and Experiences industry. Our comprehensive suite of tools enables Tour Operators, Travel agencies, and OTAs to streamline their operations and expand their reach. At Bókun, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower our users to grow their businesses and enhance customer experiences.

What You’ll Do:

Bókun is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Customer & Community Marketing Specialist to join our growth team. Reporting to the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you will be the recognised expert and driver of our customer success, engagement, and referral strategies.

You will roll up your sleeves to execute day-to-day community programs while simultaneously designing the long-term, scalable frameworks. As a unique cross-brand initiative, you will lead community building and engagement across our whole supplier community working closely alongside a team of specialists in Content Marketing, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Growth Marketing.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build & Execute the Community Strategy:  You'll develop, launch, and manage spaces where tour and attraction businesses can learn and network. This includes getting hands-on with designing and executing educational programs, webinars, newsletters, and social content for our global network of experience operators.
  • Drive Community Initiatives: You will directly manage and execute community-building efforts, content, and engagement strategies for the whole supplier community, sharing best practices across the entire Experience operator industry.
  • Drive the Referral Program: You'll collaborate directly with the PMM to enhance brand/product affinity and build scalable campaigns that drive a significant increase in customer referrals.
  • Own Customer Communication Channels: Take ownership of our primary customer communication channels, specifically leading initiatives and campaigns through platforms like Intercom and ActiveCampaign to drive consistent operator engagement.
  • Scaling Reactivation Campaigns: You will use quantitative and qualitative data research to understand root causes of suppliers who don’t upgrade from Free plans, building highly efficient, scalable frameworks for customer reactivation and retention in the process.
  • Brand Engagement & Social Media Champion: You will actively develop and implement a hands-on brand engagement strategy and content plan for our community channels to increase reach, engagement, and ultimately drive qualified leads.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Mentorship: You'll collaborate seamlessly with Content, Partnerships, and Sales to integrate community initiatives into broader growth campaigns. As a Principal IC, you will act as a role model, proactively offering guidance, insights, and mentorship to junior team members.

The Ideal Candidate:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in community/customer marketing or a related field.
  • Proven track record of building and nurturing online communities.
  • Strong practical experience managing and executing campaigns through customer communication platforms such as Intercom and ActiveCampaign.
  • Possesses "AI native thinking" to innovate and optimise how we interact with and empower our operator community.
  • You don't just track basic metrics; you analyse trends to propose data-driven solutions and continuously improve recurring engagement activities.
  • Comfortable speaking in-person and online to large audiences.
  • Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to seamlessly balance responsibilities.
  • Can effectively prioritise tasks and adjust strategies based on community feedback and needs.
  • You are comfortable sharing complex insights with senior stakeholders and enjoy mentoring junior colleagues.
  • Proactively identifies challenges, improves processes, and challenges the status quo.
  • A keen interest and passion for travel, technology, and empowering tour and activity operators.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

 

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Corporate Security
description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Hundreds of engineers and thousands of freight operators around the world rely on Flexport's internal systems every single day to keep billions of dollars of freight moving. Keeping those systems — and the people who use them — secure is not a compliance checkbox. It's the core infrastructure for a company operating across 112 countries.

The PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own the security of Flexport's corporate environment: endpoints, identity systems, internal networks, and the SaaS estate. This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role, and not a role where you write policies and hope for the best. You'll build, automate, and be on the ground when things get real.

What You'll Do

Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own and mature our endpoint security stack (EDR) across macOS and Windows fleets, writing device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules — with staged rollout and rollback built in.
  • Own security configuration and monitoring for Flexport's critical SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar) through SSPM tooling, catching risky OAuth grants and configuration drift before they become incidents.

Access management

  • Drive Flexport's identity posture: SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA and passkey rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate.
  • Lead Flexport's zero-trust journey — making sure the right people have the right access, with the right controls, verified continuously.

Detection & response

  • Build and tune detection rules in our SIEM, turning signal into actionable alerts, not noise.
  • Lead incident response for security events: triage, contain, remediate, and write the retrospective.

Vulnerability & risk management

  • Run regular assessments of corporate endpoints and prioritize findings by real business risk.
  • Manage vendor and third-party security reviews, working with procurement and legal to evaluate risk before it lands in our environment.

Security enablement & leadership

  • Partner with IT, Engineering, and People teams to embed security into the way we work without creating friction that drives people to workarounds.
  • Develop and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and internal documentation that make the whole team more capable, and mentor engineers earlier in their career.
  • Bring a point of view on how agentic AI tools and browser-based AI assistants change what corporate security needs to watch for.

You Should Have

  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in enterprise security, corporate IT security, or information security engineering — we care more about what you've built than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply.
  • Strong working knowledge of endpoint security tooling: DLP (Cyberhaven, Purview, Varonis, or similar) and EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar).
  • Practical SIEM experience, writing detection logic, triaging alerts, and reducing false positive noise.
  • Experience leading or playing a significant role in security incident response.
  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

Nice to Have

  • Experience with network security in a cloud-first environment (ZTNA, SASE, DNS filtering).
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform) for security configuration management.
  • Familiarity with SCIM, OIDC, and fine-grained authorization at scale.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, global technology company.
  • Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar, for automating detection, response, and operational tasks.
  • Exposure to privacy regulations relevant to a European and global context (GDPR, etc.).

How We Work

  • We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together.
  • We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.
  • We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why This Role Is Special

  • Broad ownership: you're not a cog in a large security org — you own the corporate security posture end to end, from endpoints to observability to incident response.
  • Real stakes: Flexport operates in 112 countries with a global workforce. Security here matters at a genuine scale.
  • Build, don't just operate: we want to automate and engineer our way to a stronger posture, not just run playbooks.
  • You're part of PSI: the platform, security, and infrastructure teams work hand in hand at Flexport. We value engineering quality and treat security as infrastructure, not just policy.
  • We sponsor visas for the right candidate.

What's in it for you

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you'll have the chance to create a global impact while being part of a thriving multinational environment.
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on a daily basis.
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam.
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full-time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport.
  • A defined pension contribution scheme.
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your family during one of the most important times in life — the birth of a child. Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. 

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one. That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

 

THE ROLE

As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.

 

THE ADS TEAM

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.
  • Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.
  • Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.
  • Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.
  • Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.
  • First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery. 
  • Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).
  • Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)
  • A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products
  • Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)
  • Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations
  • Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills  
  • Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.


WHY JOIN US? 

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate: trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

description:
About Aiven

Aiven is the open source based data platform that builders trust to run PostgreSQL®, Apache Kafka®, ClickHouse®, OpenSearch®, Valkey™ and more in production, on any cloud. Builders ship faster. Their companies run on data that stays available, secure and under control.

The role

You own the commercial relationship with a book of existing Aiven customers across the UK & Ireland, worth more than $4m in ARR. Your job is to keep those customers, grow them, and turn their success into proof for the next customer. You spot risk early, and find the next use case before the customer asks for it. 

You also open new doors: cold and warm outreach into accounts that look like your best customers, from first conversation through close.

You lead with AI from the front. It shapes how you plan, how you engage and what you say in every customer conversation. Agents do the research, monitoring and first drafts; you decide what matters and where to push. The outcome is growth: more ARR retained, more expanded and more pipeline created, earlier and more predictably.

Why now: Aiven has ambitious growth plans, and we're on track. Every customer we serve is building AI, and AI depends on the data platform underneath it. Our open source based platform means no lock-in, so builders ship faster and our customers move with more innovation velocity. You sit at the centre of that, working with customers from Fintech and AI innovators through to Utilities whose AI ambitions depend on us.

What you will do

Own the strategic partnership

  • Grow each account in your book beyond its current baseline in usage and commitments. This is the primary mandate of the role.
  • Build and run an account plan for every priority account, with clear goals, stakeholders, risks and expansion opportunities across the Aiven platform.
  • Partner with Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers on technical validation, and bring in Product Engineering, Aiven leadership and executives where a customer needs senior backing.

Retain and grow ARR

  • Spot contraction and churn risk early, using usage and sentiment signals surfaced by agents, then act on them before the customer does. Build a protection plan for each risk with the Aiven customer team.
  • Find cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the Aiven platform, and see them through to close.
  • Run renewals as a plan, not an event. Know the commercial position, the decision makers and the competing options well before the renewal date. Lead commercial and contract negotiation through to signature.
  • Qualify and manage every renewal, expansion and new logo opportunity with MEDDPICC.

Build relationships at every level

  • Build relationships with the builders who use the Aiven platform day to day (engineering, platform and product leads) and the teams who consume the services it delivers.
  • Build relationships with executives, budget holders and senior IT decision makers.

Turn happy customers into proof

  • Use your relationships to build positive sentiment, then work with Marketing to turn it into events, webinars, case studies and references matched to the right prospect.
  • Represent Aiven at UKI industry events, and feed customer, competitive and market insight back to Product, Engineering and leadership.

Open new doors

  • Own new logo opportunities in the UKI territory, from prospecting through close, using cold and warm outreach.

Run the book AI-native

  • Own how your work gets done: decide which tasks you do, which agents do and which stop entirely. Review this as the tools improve.
  • Run account research, risk and usage monitoring, outreach drafting and forecasting through agents. Spend your time on judgment, relationships and negotiation.
  • Keep Salesforce accurate so the forecast, and the agents reading it, reflect reality.
  • Share what works with the team. The way you work is a product too.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience owning a book of existing customers in enterprise B2B software, with a record of retaining and growing ARR, managing renewals and churn risk, and negotiating contracts.
  • Experience selling to technical users and to executive buyers, and adjusting your message for each.
  • A structured approach to account planning and multi-threading.
  • Clear communication in English, written and spoken.
  • Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your sales workflow, with examples of work you have redesigned or cut as a result.
  • High agency: a record of owning accounts end-to-end and solving hard problems without waiting for a blueprint.

Nice to have

  • Experience co-selling with cloud providers and partners.
  • Comfort with usage-based or consumption pricing, and with using usage data to spot risk and opportunity.
  • Experience selling open source based data technology.
  • Experience running customer advocacy: references, case studies, event speakers.

How we measure success

  • Quota attainment, net revenue retention and gross revenue retention for your book, against target.
  • Expansion ARR from cross-sell and upsell, against target.
  • Churn and contraction risks flagged early, each with a documented protection plan.
  • Executive and budget holder coverage across priority accounts.
  • Customer references, case studies and event speakers delivered each year.
  • Pipeline creation, deal progression and on-time opportunity booking.
  • Forecast accuracy and CRM hygiene.
  • Time spent on customer conversations vs. admin and research, trending the right way quarter on quarter.
  • Workflow improvements adopted by the wider team.

Role context

  • Team: Field Sales EMEA South.
  • Book: more than $4m ARR across existing customers.
  • Customers: Fintech and AI innovators through to Utilities.
  • Reports to: EMEA South Sales Director.
  • First 90 days: learn the business, the technology, your customer base and how we work.
  • Focus: existing customers first, with new logo opportunities in UKI.
  • Works closely with: Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, Support, Product Engineering, Marketing, Sales Development and Aiven leadership.
  • Location: London, UK, with the right to work there. Hybrid working, with regular time together in the London hub for planning and deal reviews, and travel to customers as needed. Adjustments available.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.
  • Improved user experience: personalised game recommendation, game representation, spam detection, etc.
  • Content localization: (multimodal) translation, quality assurance, etc.
  • Model distillation for realtime performance

What we're looking for

  • An ongoing or recently completed (within the last 12 months) PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI or a related field
  • A record of publication in top conferences/journals
  • Experience implementing deep learning algorithms for problems in computer vision, natural language processing, or speech/audio processing
  • Hands-on knowledge of state-of-the-art ML methods, such as Transformers, diffusion models, and reinforcement learning
  • Experience with post-training foundation models, including SFT, preference training, and reinforcement learning
  • Excellent AI coding and experimental engineering skills
  • Desirable: game development experience in either C++ or C#

Internship Details

  • Duration: 5-12 months initially (depending on your location), with flexible start-dates throughout 2026/2027
  • Hours: full-time (40 hours/week) or part-time (20 hours/week)
  • Location: Select regions within the UK, US or Canada
  • Employment Authorization: You must hold an existing right to work in the UK, US or Canada for the full duration of the internship - Visa sponsorship or support is unavailable for this role
  • Publishing: Research by Epic interns is regularly published in top-tier conferences

This internship has a flexible start date in 2026/2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.

  • Growth Mindset: proactively identify and close gaps in own knowledge.
  • Accountability: strong attention to detail in own work.
  • Role Model: demonstrate leadership across the Executive level within the team.

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.

As a member of our London-based Infrastructure and Platform Engineering team, this position supports our multi-tenant private and public cloud initiatives.

The role contributes to the delivery of services to our core business areas globally, including Trading, middle and back office, and Technology. The role requires an understanding of platforms including Windows, virtualisation and their associated technologies, delivered through on-premises, hosted and public cloud environments. It involves system integration, support and continuous improvement, with an emphasis on standardisation, repeatability, automation and orchestration.

The successful candidate will cover BAU rota activities alongside business project initiatives. We are looking for a proactive self-starter who can manage their workload, identify opportunities for improvement and work alongside senior engineers to develop their experience in solution design, scoping and architecture across our key technology platforms.

With the team’s broad technology remit, this role would suit someone early in their Windows platform engineering career who is keen to build their experience in a fast-paced environment and gain exposure to a wide range of technologies.

Experience Required:

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest. Our mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives extends beyond borders. Consumers across the globe need safe, transparent financing. Our retail partners need Affirm to be there for them, wherever that might be. To help achieve this vision, we are expanding our product lines and becoming a global company.

The International Consumer product team is responsible for building and scaling Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products and experiences across international markets. This includes our apps, wallets, marketplace, and related offerings that help consumers discover, use, and manage Affirm.

As a Senior Product Manager on the International Consumer team, you will drive the strategy, execution, and growth of Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products across international markets – from iterating on the product vision, refining the product strategy, developing a roadmap, and leading execution.
In this role, you will work closely with a broad set of cross functional teams across the entire business, as well as a number of engineering teams. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be commercially minded, be high agency with a bias towards action, and comfortable having technical conversations (and opinions). 

 

What You'll Do

  • Drive the execution, growth, and scale of Affirm’s consumer products and experiences across international markets

  • Take Affirm’s direct-to-consumer products and adapt them for international markets by understanding consumer needs, analyzing performance data, and iterating on the product’s features and capabilities

  • Drive success metrics by shipping high impact work that meaningfully moves the needle for Affirm’s business and customers

  • Partner effectively with engineering teams across the organization to drive product development and prioritization

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (such as Design, Research, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Credit, Fraud, etc.) to shape your product roadmap and incorporate legal, governance, and regulatory oversight into your products

  • Understand Affirm’s international consumers at a deep level: what’s important to them, what drives their decision making, why they love Affirm, and what they wish we could do better

What you’ll do Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards. Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement. Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance. Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision. Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact. Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience. Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness. Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings. Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve. Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve. Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues. The Staff Full Stack Engineer is responsible for setting technical direction across multiple squads, typically overseeing 2–3 squads and line-managing 3–5 Full Stack Engineers. The role exists to shape architecture, ensure the success of these squads, and drive consistent, secure, and compliant delivery across Allica’s digital products.

You will use your expertise in Spring Boot microservices (Java/Kotlin) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript) to define and evolve cross-squad patterns, shared tooling, and platform capabilities.

Our backend microservices are containerised and deployed to Azure Container Apps, and our web applications are deployed to Azure Static Web Apps; you will help define and uphold the standards that make these platforms robust, cost-effective, and easy to operate.

You will own key cross-cutting concerns such as authentication, observability, performance, accessibility, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our systems meet the standards expected of a UK bank.

You are hands-on: you design and review architectures, pair with engineers, and contribute code to high-impact initiatives.

You work closely with Product, Design and other engineering leaders to align technical direction with business goals and to unblock delivery.

You drive the responsible adoption of GenAI and agentic engineering practices (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot), setting organisation-wide standards and measuring impact.

Success in this role is reflected in simpler architectures, improved delivery consistency and reliability, stronger engineering effectiveness, and the growth and performance of your direct reports and squads.

Principal Accountabilities

Set and evolve cross-squad technical patterns and guardrails for:

  • Backend services (Kotlin/Java Spring Boot microservices, REST/OpenAPI, messaging, integrations).

  • Lead cross-squad system design for complex initiatives, ensuring coherent architectures, well-managed dependencies, clear domain boundaries, and effective interactions between services and frontends.

  • Shape and continuously improve cloud-native deployment patterns on Azure (Container Apps, Static Web Apps, networking, configuration, and scaling), working closely with Platform Engineering teams.

  • Drive improvements to developer experience (CI/CD, local development workflows, test strategy, release processes) across multiple squads, leveraging GitHub, Azure DevOps and other approved tools.

Define and champion responsible AI-assisted engineering practices, including:

  • Standards for using Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and other approved GenAI tools.

  • Expectations for review and validation of AI-generated code.

  • Measurement and optimisation of productivity gains and quality improvements.

  • Mentor and line-manage Senior Full Stack Engineers, supporting their growth in technical leadership, people leadership, and impact across squads.

  • Foster a culture of learning and continuous improvement through communities of practice, architecture forums, and regular knowledge-sharing.

  • Influence and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders (Product, Design, Operations, Risk, Compliance), aligning technical strategies with product and business roadmaps.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed systems at scale using Spring Boot (Kotlin/Java) and modern web technologies (React/TypeScript).

  • Proven track record of simplifying complex architectures and defining cross-team patterns and platforms in a multi-squad environment.

  • Deep understanding of secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP), privacy, auditability, and regulatory expectations in financial services or similarly regulated environments.

  • Experience designing and governing APIs at scale (REST, OpenAPI, API gateways, versioning, backwards compatibility, service contracts).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical programmes or initiatives that span multiple teams and systems, delivering measurable improvements to reliability, performance, or developer productivity.

  • Experience introducing and scaling the use of new tools and standards across organisations, including GenAI technologies (e.g. GitHub Copilot) with appropriate guardrails.

Därt führst du uns durch dein Portfolio. Im zweiten Schritt stellst du uns vor, wie du ein Ad-System für Qstar aufbauen würdest. Diesen Case vergüten wir. Dann Kennenlernen im Team. description: We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly! Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation.
