title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques. PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne. Compétences techniques • Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision. • Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid. • Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15- 140 / COFRAC). • Analyse de données de température. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique. Qualités personnelles • Sens de l'organisation. • Rigueur et méthode. • Esprit d'analyse. • Capacité de prise de décision. • Aisance relationnelle. • Force de proposition. • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs. • Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence. Objectifs du poste • Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules. • Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique. • Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température. • Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport. • Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Finance (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für den Finanzbereich an den beiden Standorten Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit dem lokalen Management zusammen und sorgen für Transparenz, einheitliche Finanzprozesse sowie eine verlässliche Berichterstattung.

Sie führen die Bereiche Accounting und Controlling und stehen im regelmässigen Austausch mit den lokalen Führungsteams sowie dem Coesia Headquarter. Darüber hinaus gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung der Finanzorganisation an beiden Standorten aktiv mit.

Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt in Kaiseraugst (ca. 80 %), mit regelmässiger Präsenz in Altendorf (ca. 20 %). Die Reisetätigkeit zwischen den beiden Standorten ist ein fester Bestandteil der Rolle.

Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortungen

  • Verantwortung für das gesamte Finanzreporting inklusive Ist-Zahlen, Forecasts und Budgetplanung

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Bereiche Accounting und Controlling

  • Harmonisierung der beiden unterschiedlichen ERP-Systemlandschaften an den Standorten

  • Gestaltung, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Finanzprozessen und internen Kontrollen

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung transparenter Reporting-Strukturen sowie relevanter KPIs

  • Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse

  • Verantwortung für Cashflow-Reporting, Liquiditätsüberwachung und Finanzplanung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Management sowie dem Coesia Headquarter in finanziellen und strategischen Fragestellungen

  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Richtlinien, finanzieller Standards und Reporting-Anforderungen


Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Finance Manager, Head of Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsfunktion im Finanzbereich

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Accounting und Controlling

  • Erfahrung in den Bereichen Finanzreporting, Budgetierung, Forecasting und Cashflow-Management

  • Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams im Bereich Finanzen, Accounting oder Controlling

  • Berufserfahrung in der Schweiz sowie gute Kenntnisse der Schweizer Rechnungslegungsstandards

  • Erfahrung in einem produzierenden oder industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise im Maschinenbau, in der Automatisierungstechnik oder im projektorientierten Geschäft

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Fähigkeit, Strukturen und Prozesse aufzubauen, zu standardisieren und kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Erfahrung in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld und in der Zusammenarbeit mit zentralen Konzernfunktionen

  • Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld mit einem hohen Mass an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

Was wir bieten

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld

  • Attraktive Sozialleistungen und ein modernes Altersvorsorgemodell

  • Vergünstigungen beim Fahrzeugkauf

  • Dienstjubiläums- und Treueprämien

  • Unterstützung bei Aus- und Weiterbildungen

  • 25 Ferientage bis zum Alter von 49 Jahren, 28 Tage ab 50 Jahren und 30 Tage ab 60 Jahren

  • Kostenlose Parkplätze

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Verkehr

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg (Profit Sharing)

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, wenden Sie sich bitte an unsere Talent Acquisition Spezialistin, Dajana Smyrek ----- bewerben Sie sich direkt über folgenden Link:

https://www.coesia.com/modules/custom/coesia_talentlink/vendor/apply/apply.html?jobId=Q4GFK026203F3VBQB7VV4F6SL-12363&langCode=en_GB

description: Who is Sonar? Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable. Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code. We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like: SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE: Committed to our customers and community. Obsessed with quality. Deliberate in our decisions. Effective as one team. With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you. Position description We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join the CI Experience squad within our Code Orchestration department. The CI Experience squad enables users to analyze their projects in their own CI, making analysis a core part of their workflow. We have a mission to make analysis reliable, fast, configurable and developer-friendly. What you will do Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and engineers to build the best CI-based analysis experience. Contribute well tested and production ready code. Participate in the on-call operation of analysis infrastructure, including feature deployments, production monitoring, incident response, and troubleshooting. Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals. Experience and qualifications MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience). 0-3 years of professional software engineering experience. Proficiency with Java. Solid engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to reason about correctness and performance Nice to have Familiarity with a variety of build systems and CI runners. In-office culture We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: IN SHORT Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory. Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites. Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations. Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet. Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations. Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team. Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software. Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first. Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans. Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup. YOUR PROFILE Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework. Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait. Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin. Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous. Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code. Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers. High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end. Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus. Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food. Valid work permit or Swiss passport. OUR BENEFITS Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age. We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English. ABOUT US FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;). FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York. www.felfel.ch Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.


YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
  • Valid work permit or Swiss passport.


OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
  • Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
  • 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.
  • Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.
  • Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.
  • Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.
  • Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail latency, and cost per token. Compare serving architectures under consistent workload conditions and GPU budgets.
  • Work with MLE, GPU kernel, backend infrastructure, product, and customer teams to select research priorities with measurable production impact.
  • Share results through internal reports, technical blogs, papers, and open-source artifacts, and mentor engineers and scientists on experimental design, scientific rigor, and model/system trade-offs.

Must-haves

  • A PhD in computer science, machine learning, ML systems, computer systems, computer architecture, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or a closely related discipline.
  • A strong publication record or equivalent research artifacts in ML, ML systems, efficient inference, model compression, quantization, distillation, serving systems, or related areas.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch implementation skills, with the ability to turn ideas into experiments and working prototypes.
  • Deep knowledge of LLMs, VLMs, transformer inference, decoding algorithms, model compression, quantization, and production-serving trade-offs.
  • Strong experimental design skills covering ablations, baselines, metrics, statistical reasoning, and failure analysis.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-haves

  • First-author publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys, ACL, EMNLP, ASPLOS, OSDI, SOSP, ISCA, or HPCA.
  • Experience deploying ML models or inference optimizations in production.
  • Experience with vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, NVIDIA Dynamo, FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, CUDA, or PyTorch internals.
  • Experience applying post-training, SFT, DPO, RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or synthetic data generation to inference quality or efficiency.
  • Open-source research artifacts, widely used benchmarks, technical blogs, or invited talks demonstrating contributions to efficient AI systems.
  • Research or implementation experience in one or more areas of distributed inference system architecture, such as LLM request routing, PDD, multi-node serving, or MoE expert parallelism, including WideEP.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use. You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems. Cold-Weather Industrial Plant Experience : You have hands-on experience working with industrial plants in cold-weather environments (e.g. Canada, Nordic countries, or similar climates) and understand the operational, maintenance, and safety challenges associated with extreme weather conditions. Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations. Working Style: You are precise, adaptable, and reliable, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. You are highly organized, able to plan and prioritize work for yourself and others, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments. At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers.

Your Mission

On our path to becoming the most visited online curated marketplace for special objects, our Engineering team is on a mission to deliver the best experience across our platforms by building best-in-class products for search and discovery, bidding, curation, logistics, payments, and support.

We’re a scale-up tackling customer-facing challenges at high scale, with 75,000 auctions per week and more than 10 million visitors per month. As a Backend Engineer, you’ll support one of our three verticals - Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment - improving and delivering product innovations for our platform.
Working in a small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile team, you will build scalable, maintainable, and resilient microservices and features. That’s why we’re looking for developers who share ideas, explore options, and communicate openly.

What You'll Do

You’ll be part of a team with end-to-end responsibility for its own microservices, collaborating across disciplines to build, operate, and continuously improve our products.

  • Build end-to-end by designing, developing, testing, deploying, maintaining, and improving scalable microservices and features.
  • Own what you deliver, taking responsibility for the quality, resilience, and maintainability of your team’s services throughout their lifecycle.
  • Collaborate across disciplines while closely working with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile engineers to share ideas and deliver product innovations.
  • Improve how we work, identifying opportunities to make our engineering processes more effective and efficient.
  • Strengthen our engineering culture by documenting and advocating for development best practices across the team.
  • Raise product quality by fixing bugs and refactoring the codebase where necessary to keep our products reliable and maintainable.
  • Learn and experiment by testing new technologies and participating in Technical Week - a week dedicated to creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains after every two product sprints.

What You'll Bring

You understand the full lifecycle of web development, identify opportunities, explore solutions, and keep customer needs at the center of your work. Our stack is mainly focused on Ruby; however, prior Ruby experience is not essential if you’re passionate about learning new things.

  • Strong software engineering foundations: 7+ years of software development experience, specifically with object-oriented programming.
  • Relevant product experience: 3+ years of experience working with customer-facing products in industries such as e-commerce, fintech, or SaaS.
  • Backend service expertise: Experience designing, implementing, and deploying backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency, and consistency.
  • API and data knowledge: A good understanding of API design, SQL, and relational databases.
  • Clear communication: Excellent English communication skills and comfort raising concerns, sharing ideas, and documenting your work.
  • Collaborative mindset: You contribute to the team, take initiative, and step in to help when needed.
  • Solution-oriented thinking: You actively identify opportunities and explore alternative approaches to solving problems.
  • Commitment to growth: You take ownership of developing your skills by learning new technologies and seeking new opportunities.

How We Work

Our engineers work in small, fully autonomous, and highly collaborative Agile teams aligned with one of three verticals: Demand, Supply, or Fulfilment.

  • Teams are responsible for their own microservices from design and development through deployment, maintenance, and improvement.
  • Engineers collaborate closely with product designers, product owners, and frontend, backend, and mobile colleagues.
  • We value bold thinking, curiosity, openness, initiative, and a strong customer focus.
  • Technical Week creates dedicated space for experimentation, creativity, innovation, and knowledge sharing across domains.

Where You'll Be

This is a Hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will work from our Lisbon Hub a minimum of 2 days per week.
At this time, we are only considering candidates who are already based in Portugal. As a result, visa sponsorship and relocation support are not available for this position.

In Return

You’ll be part of an enthusiastic, highly motivated team of 800+ Catawikians.

  • A competitive Annual Gross Base Salary depending on your level, competencies, and overall experience.
  • Meal Allowance Card stipend per working day, in addition to salary.
  • Health Insurance from day 1 (including dental coverage), with access to multiple hospitals and clinics and a vast wellness network.
  • A Work From Home Allowance to help with your monthly household bills.
  • Commuting between your home and our office is covered by Catawiki.
  • Amazing Office right in the centre of Lisbon.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Full Stack Web Engineer
description: Location: Remote – Latin America (Open to applicants located anywhere in the LATAM region) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria's Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. As a Full Stack Web Engineer at Fueled, your mission is to turn well-defined tickets and user stories into clean, production-ready code that powers large-scale digital experiences. Working within enterprise WordPress engagements, you'll build and deliver features end-to-end, from the frontend experience to modern PHP, JavaScript, and Gutenberg blocks in React.js. You'll bring designs and requirements to life within themes and plugins, moving quickly and confidently by pairing your own craft with AI-assisted workflows, thorough documentation, and the support of senior engineers who review and elevate your work. This is a role for engineers who love the craft: you write code you're proud of, you welcome sharp code review, and you treat AI tools as a force multiplier, not a substitute for understanding. You should be comfortable taking a feature from requirements through implementation, making sound decisions along the way, and delivering a polished, production-ready result. Your work will ship to platforms serving millions of visitors, alongside a team recognized as one of the top enterprise WordPress practices in the world. Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. For engineers in Latin America, that means real-time collaboration with US-based teams during your normal working day, compensation in USD, and a seat at the table on projects for globally recognized brands – all from wherever you work best. Together, we're shaping the future of digital experiences. What you will do: Build features for enterprise-level WordPress solutions – custom Gutenberg blocks in React.js, plugins, and themes using modern HTML/CSS and well-structured PHP. Own tickets end-to-end: understand the requirements, make sound decisions when details are incomplete, and deliver reviewable pull requests with clear summaries of your approach, assumptions, and testing. Bring designs and user experiences to life by translating Figma designs and other project requirements into polished, responsive features and reusable components within WordPress themes and plugins. Leverage AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow to accelerate implementation and debugging while critically validating every output before it reaches a pull request. Iterate on code review feedback from senior and lead engineers, absorbing patterns and best practices that sharpen your craft with every merge. Collaborate proactively and asynchronously in English with distributed teammates across engineering, design, and delivery. What you will achieve: Within your first month, you'll have shipped merged, production-ready pull requests on a live client project, demonstrating that you can take written direction and run with it. By the 3-month mark, you'll be independently owning tickets from requirement to release, with review cycles getting shorter as your grasp of our conventions deepens. Your AI-assisted workflow will have measurably accelerated delivery on your project – without ever compromising the quality bar our clients expect. You'll have earned the trust of your engineering leads as a dependable contributor whose PRs are a pleasure to review. By the end of your contract, you'll have a portfolio of enterprise-grade work, sharpened skills, and a standing invitation for future collaboration. About you: You have solid agency or consultancy experience building WordPress solutions for large-scale, enterprise projects – high-traffic sites, demanding clients, real deadlines. You're comfortable working across the web stack, including HTML, CSS, modern PHP, JavaScript, and the Gutenberg ecosystem, including building custom blocks with React.js. Bonus points if you've worked with our open-source tools, like ElasticPress or ClassifAI – tell us about it in your application. AI tools are already part of how you work: you use them to move faster, and you know exactly when they're wrong. You're passionate about sharpening your craft – you read best practices for fun, seek out code review, and never ship code you don't understand. You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken, and can confidently walk a reviewer through your decisions, assumptions, and tradeoffs. You're based in Latin America, and thrive on a distributed team, collaborating in real time with US time zones from the remote location of your choice. Contractor Fee Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Contractor fees are paid in USD. Join our Contractor Pool This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. When the fit and business needs align, some contractors are invited to explore a transition into full-time roles. If you are passionate about Fueled's mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role, even if you don't check all the boxes – please apply. We'd appreciate the opportunity to review your application. Everyone gets a response. Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise. Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy . Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here .

raw.jobDescription:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might know us as ZnanyLekarz in Poland or Doctoralia in Spain. Globally, we are Docplanner.

We build technology that helps people live longer, healthier lives. Our products connect patients with doctors, power clinical workflows, and support healthcare systems used by millions of people every month.

Engineering at Docplanner is about building reliable, scalable systems with real human impact. What we ship affects patients, doctors, and clinics in everyday, high-stakes situations - which means quality, judgment, and long-term thinking matter.

In 2026, we are accelerating delivery across multiple product areas by changing how we build - leveraging AI-assisted development to increase engineering effectiveness and raise the bar on how we design, ship, and evolve systems.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to help people live longer, healthier lives, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self. You can decide to work fully remote, or work hybrid with our offices located in Barcelona or Warsaw. This will be dependent on the final team allocation.

Our challenges

Our Engineers may join teams working on these areas and challenges:

Marketplace & Search

Build the next-generation marketplace system by owning the end-to-end journey from agentic discovery to rebooking. You’ll leverage AI search and AI onboarding funnels to unlock new demand and transform one-off bookings into continuous care loops.

Practice Management Systems (PMS)

Build the next generation of software to help doctors globally. Unify the current fragmented reality and leverage AI to reinvent the way to help doctors focus on what matters most: treating the patient.

AI-powered Clinical Tools (Noa Medic)

Design AI-native clinical workflows that move beyond simple scribing to replace end-to-end administrative tasks. You'll build deep PMS/EHR embeddings that become an indispensable daily habit for medical professionals.

Patient & Data Integrations (Noa Patient)

Move beyond the booking button to build a proactive healthcare partner. You'll create the smart connections that blend someone's medical past with their live health data, crafting an AI experience that actually keeps patients coming back. Turn raw data into advice people can use, making Docplanner the one health app they can't live without.

Internally, these challenges map to some of our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives.

How we build software

  • We build systems that matter and we optimize for clarity, speed, and long-term maintainability.

  • Small autonomous teams that own real product surfaces end-to-end

  • High trust and high ownership from day one

  • Production impact early - even as a junior engineer

  • AI-assisted development as a default workflow

  • Strong engineering culture focused on simplicity, correctness, and measurable outcomes

  • We prefer solving problems well over adding unnecessary complexity.

  • Good ideas win regardless of tenure or hierarchy.

What we value

Strong problem solving ability. The ability to break down complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Builder mindset. You like creating things that people use.

Intellectual curiosity. You enjoy understanding how systems really work.

Ownership. You treat problems as yours until they are solved.

Pragmatism. You know when to optimize and when to ship.

We value signals over credentials.

Competition programming, open-source work, research, side projects or anything else that shows how you think.

Technical Environment

  • Our stack evolves continuously, but currently includes technologies such as:

  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript

  • Mobile: React Native

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform

  • Developer tooling: modern CI/CD, observability

  • AI-assisted coding environments built to scale (guardrails, rules, skills, subagents, spec-driven development)

We invest heavily in developer productivity and continuously improve how we design and ship systems.

Collaboration Model

• Open source internal culture - contribute across different services and teams

• Maintainer guidance rather than gatekeeping from senior developers

• Cross-functional ownership of features from conception to deployment

• Living documentation shared across all team members

Why Junior Devs Love It Here

  • Some reasons engineers choose to stay at Docplanner:

  • Real scale. Millions of users and thousands of healthcare providers across multiple countries.

  • Interesting problems. Distributed systems, search relevance, AI-assisted workflows, complex integrations.

  • Exceptional teammates. Work with talented people across disciplines who raise the bar for everyone.

  • Fast learning curve. You will work on real production systems very early.

  • Meaningful mission. Helping people live longer, healthier lives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong foundations in computer science

  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, complexity, and core software engineering principles.

  • Ability to build real software

  • Comfortable working across the stack to design, implement, and ship features that solve real user problems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • You enjoy breaking down complex problems and finding simple, effective solutions.

  • Builder mindset

  • You like turning ideas into working products and taking ownership of outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Curiosity about users and problems

  • You’re comfortable talking to users, understanding their needs, and iterating on solutions.

  • High learning velocity

  • You pick up new technologies, tools, and domains quickly and continuously improve your craft.

  • AI-first engineering mindset

  • You actively experiment with AI coding tools, agents, and new workflows, and are excited about reinventing how software is built.

Preferred

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or another rigorous technical discipline.

  • Competitive programming experience

  • Participation in ICPC, Google Code Jam, national olympiads, Codeforces, or similar competitions.

  • Evidence of building things

  • Side projects, startups, open-source contributions, hackathons, or shipped products.

  • Exposure to modern engineering workflows

  • Experience working with collaborative development, continuous delivery, strong observability, and AI-assisted development practices.

Benefits

  • Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings;

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona;

  • Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

  • Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier);

  • 23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays;

Health comes first

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

Revenue at Alma covers the entire customer lifecycle, from lead generation to churn. It brings together Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management, representing more than 100 talented professionals.

Revenue Operations plays a key role in helping these teams work together around shared goals, reliable data and efficient processes. The team supports Revenue leaders in improving performance, making better decisions and scaling the organisation.

This position is a permanent contract, based in Paris, with 2 days of remote work per week.

You will report to Basil Lizotte, and work closely with Revenue teams, the Central Data Team, Ops & Risk, Product and Tech.

💼 About the job

As Senior Business Analyst, Revenue Operations, you will create strategic insights that help Alma's Revenue teams understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and improve their speed and efficiency.

You will work at the intersection of data, business and strategy, turning complex questions into clear recommendations and practical tools.

Build reliable data foundations for Revenue

  • Build and evolve business-facing data models by combining relevant CRM, revenue and operational data sources.
  • Improve and maintain existing models and contribute to reliable end-to-end data pipelines.

Turn business questions into strategic insights

  • Analyse Alma's target markets, market share, market dynamics and the key drivers behind commercial wins.
  • Design ad hoc tools and models to help Revenue teams answer tactical business questions and make faster decisions.

Improve performance monitoring and revenue growth

  • Build and manage dashboards, KPIs and revenue forecasts so teams and leadership can monitor business health and progress against their goals.
  • Support Revenue leaders in setting the right targets, understanding growth dynamics and prioritising their roadmap.

Drive data excellence across Revenue

  • Promote data-informed ways of working across Marketing, Partnerships, Sales and Account Management.
  • Collaborate closely with the Central Data Team to maintain high standards of data quality and consistency across the organisation.

🧰 You will work with

SQL, Looker, LookML, Claude Code, Python, dbt, BigQuery, GCP, Rudderstack, Segment, Salesforce

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large datasets, raw CRM data and revenue-related information, including Salesforce data.
  • You have experience building business-facing data models, dashboards, forecasts or performance analyses from the initial question through to clear recommendations.
  • You can define relevant KPIs, assess business impact and communicate complex analysis in a clear and actionable way to different stakeholders.
  • You have approximately 4 to 7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing technology or fintech environment.

And it will be nice if you also

  • You have experience with Looker and LookML.
  • You are comfortable with Python and modern data tools such as dbt, BigQuery or GCP.
  • You have worked with tracking tools such as Rudderstack or Segment, as well as experimentation methodologies such as A/B testing, significance testing and causal analysis.
  • You are curious about AI-assisted tools and are interested in using tools such as Claude Code in your daily workflow.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 Your Alma experience

The culture

At Alma, collective intelligence is at the heart of the way we work. We are building an international company in a fast-growing environment, where people are encouraged to take ownership, share ideas and learn from one another.

You will have access to our Learning & Development Platform, regular feedback and opportunities to develop your expertise and career path. As Alma continues to grow across Europe, you will have the opportunity to work with colleagues from different teams, countries and areas of expertise.

We are committed to building a fair and inclusive workplace. We monitor our gender equality index and remain committed to pay equity, transparency and equal opportunities across the organisation.

The role itself

If you join Alma, you will be able to grow and have an impact by:

  • Influencing strategic decisions across the full Revenue organisation, from lead generation to churn.
  • Combining analytical depth, business understanding and direct exposure to senior stakeholders.
  • Helping Revenue teams build a stronger data culture and create more efficient ways of working as Alma scales across Europe.

🤑 Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma, including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and ClassPass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave, with no seniority requirement. Return to work at a 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year, excluding full-remote contracts
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to the MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days per year, plus additional paid leave granted to employees on executive contracts
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote work possible per year during the summer

🎯 Interview process

  • Video screen with Lydia a Talent Acquisition team member to discuss your background, motivation and the role.
  • Experience interview with Basil Lizotte or/and Gaspard Zha, lasting 45 minutes, to discuss the role, the team and your experience.
  • Home assignment and case study, lasting 1 hour, with members team. 
  • On-site team fit interview, lasting 30 minutes. 
  • On-site N+2 interview with Antoine de la Rivière, lasting 30 minutes. 
  • Reference check with at least two professional references.

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work, whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit and business needs.

Rejoindre Exotec , c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités. description: Chez Exotec , nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels. À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes. Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes : Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives. Développer des outils d’analyse : concevoir vos propres outils software pour exploiter les données, diagnostiquer les problèmes et évaluer les performances des systèmes. Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software. Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware. Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées. Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration. Votre profil Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation supérieure technique en mécatronique, systèmes embarqués, génie industriel ou dans un domaine connexe, ou vous avez acquis une expérience équivalente. Vous avez une expérience en conception, développement ou validation de systèmes techniques et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche de panne et l’analyse des causes racines. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils de développement, le versioning et l’analyse de données. Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre software et hardware et êtes capable de comprendre les interactions entre les différents composants d’un système. Vous êtes familier(ère) avec les méthodes quantitatives appliquées à la fiabilité : MTTF, MTBF, loi de Weibull ou analyse statistique des défaillances. Vous êtes curieux(se), structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), avec une approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes. Vous savez remettre en question vos hypothèses, approfondir vos analyses et rechercher de nouvelles connaissances lorsque cela est nécessaire. Vous aimez collaborer avec des ingénieurs aux expertises variées, qu’elles soient orientées hardware, software ou systèmes. Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Votre mission consistera à définir la vision, piloter l'évolution et maximiser l'adoption des solutions collaboratives qui soutiennent les activités de l'entreprise. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes. Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business. Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages. Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée. Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec. Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes. Développer l’adoption et animer la gouvernance Définir et porter la stratégie d’adoption des outils collaboratifs afin d’ancrer durablement de nouveaux usages, au-delà de la seule communication ou de la formation. Aligner les métiers, la DSI, les utilisateurs clés, les éditeurs et les partenaires externes sur les priorités, les règles de gouvernance, les arbitrages et les résultats attendus. Piloter la relation avec les éditeurs et partenaires stratégiques, en maîtrisant leurs engagements, leur feuille de route, leurs risques et leurs contraintes commerciales dans l’intérêt d’Exotec. Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances. Votre profil Expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de produit ou transformation digitale. Bonne connaissance des outils collaboratifs, idéalement Microsoft 365. title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER - BRAND CONCEPTS (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE RÔLE Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact. VOS MISSIONS Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion. Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison. Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés. Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image. Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison. Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…). Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations. Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants. Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports. Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication. VOTRE PROFIL Excellente culture graphique et artistique. Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques. Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs. Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere. Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint. Très bonne maîtrise du motion design. Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création. Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes. Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth. About the role To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris. You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire. A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions. You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role. You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department. We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices. What you will do Manage recruitment processes from A to Z , from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature. Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy. Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles , including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles. Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting , identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications. Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches. Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment. Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process. Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience. Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process. Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators. Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges. Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes. Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices. What we are looking for You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment. You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team. You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant. You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach. Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels. You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly. You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders. You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals. You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices. You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers. Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role. You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets. What's in it for you A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture. The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles. title: Consulting Partner Romandie (Strategy & Data/AI Transformation)
description:
Who we are

Artefact is a global data and AI consulting firm. We help organisations turn data and AI into measurable business impact across the value chain, from strategy and operating model to data platforms, AI products and marketing. More than 2,500 consultants, data scientists and engineers work for over 1,000 clients worldwide, including Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi.

In Switzerland, our team of around 50 people works from Zurich and Lausanne with Swiss and international companies. Our work covers AI strategy and governance, data transformation and AI use cases that run in production.

What you will be doing: Key responsibilities

We are looking for a Partner to take over and grow Artefact’s commercial business in Lausanne. The office already serves clients across Romandie, and its Tech chapter is led by a Partner on site. You will take over an established client portfolio and grow it against ambitious targets: deepen existing relationships, win new accounts in industry, retail and luxury, and grow the team that delivers them.

Your role will encompass:

  • Taking over existing client relationships in Romandie through a structured handover, and growing them into broader, multi-year partnerships.
  • Opening new accounts with business leaders (CEO, COO, CMO, Chief Digital Officer, heads of business units) at industrial, retail, consumer and luxury companies in Romandie, and at the regional headquarters of international groups around Lake Geneva.
  • Growing Artefact’s Lausanne office with the Swiss Managing Partner and our Lausanne Tech Partner: more clients, more revenue and a larger team. You will also strengthen Artefact’s visibility in the French-speaking business and academic ecosystem.
  • Leading client executives through data and AI transformation, so that Artefact becomes their partner of choice for it.

Among your responsibilities as Partner, you will:

Develop the Romandie client portfolio

  • Build and run an account and go-to-market plan for Romandie: growth targets for existing clients, new target accounts and entry offers.
  • Own your pipeline and report on it monthly: qualified opportunities, conversion rate, sold revenue.
  • Write proposals that address the client’s actual problem, own scoping and pricing, and shape them with the Tech chapter so that strategy and implementation come as one offer.
  • Expand existing accounts to more buyers and business units per client.

Deliver to the highest standard

  • Sponsor engagements run day to day by Engagement Managers, with multidisciplinary teams of consultants, data scientists and data/AI engineers.
  • Be accountable for client satisfaction, project margin and team experience.

Develop our knowledge base

  • Bring a sector edge in industry, retail or luxury: where data and AI change margins, operations or customer experience, and how to package that into offers.
  • Speak and publish in French and English on data and AI topics relevant to these sectors.
  • Work with Artefact’s global industry practices to bring their assets and references to Swiss clients.

Lead and develop the Lausanne team

  • Grow the Lausanne team with Swiss leadership through hiring and internal development, and own staffing on your engagements.
  • Coach consultants on client handling, problem solving and sector knowledge.

What we are looking for

  • 12–15 years of experience, mostly in consulting: technology consulting, strategy consulting, transaction services/due diligence, or a large consulting and technology services firm. A move in-house after a consulting career is welcome.
  • Currently Director, Principal or Associate Partner with a personal sales target, ready for the step to Partner.
  • A track record of growing client relationships: you can name accounts you expanded and the revenue you sold, including clients you opened yourself.
  • Sector experience in industrial goods, retail, consumer or luxury, and a network among decision-makers in Romandie.
  • French at native or full professional level, and fluent English.
  • Working fluency in data and AI: you can discuss what an AI use case needs from data, what it costs and when it pays back, without being an engineer.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to the Lausanne area.

Why you should join us

  • Shape what comes next: the Swiss practice has proven itself and is growing fast. It is still small enough that you shape its clients, its offers and its team.
  • Sell with a global platform: you bring the credentials, delivery capacity and AI assets of a 2,500-person firm into every proposal, and you work with industry leads across Europe.
  • Strategy to production under one roof: our consultants and engineers work in the same teams, so your clients get from recommendation to working solution without changing firms.
  • Culture: innovation, collaboration and action shape how we work. Artefact Switzerland is Great Place to Work certified (2026).
  • Entrepreneurship: you are measured on the clients, revenue and team you build.

The team develops the application layer of an institutional corporate bond trading platform, supporting a range of trading protocols and workflows.

You’ll work primarily with modern C++ on Linux, building and enhancing server-side components responsible for trading workflows, order and trade lifecycle, business logic, and integrations with other systems across the platform.

Locations

  • Georgia
  • Poland
  • Portugal
  • Cyprus
  • Spain

What you will do

  • Enhance and maintain the core list-management service at the center of our electronic corporate bond trading platform, owning the full lifecycle of trade negotiation and execution across a growing set of trading protocols
  • Build and extend the integration services that bridge our platform to internal and external trading systems
  • Work in C++ on Linux in a microservices architecture built on a shared service framework with schema-driven code generation (FlatBuffers and Protobuf)
  • Contribute during all phases of the project lifecycle
  • Work with business counterparts to provide technical solutions to client needs
  • Work with QA and support teams to address issues that arise during development, testing, and in production
